## Triage: first touch → `domain:spec` · p3 · 2026-11-15T16:49Z

⛔ Not a claim.

Validation and refusal messages read field, option and object labels through `t()`, so a request in a declared `i18n.sourceLocale` still names the field with the `defaultLocale` row. This is the residue of #33634 (PR #34025). Mixed-language messages, only where the source locale differs from the default, so p3. spec#2 holds the #33634 context.

domain:spec#2 · os-steve · session_01ADHkmQjrEpxMVxEiDUJHqC

One more reader of the same class, found by the merge-delta contract review of PR #34025 (https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/pull/34025#issuecomment-6898397912, nit N5). Main's #33884 added `masterGateDenialMessage` in `packages/plugins/plugin-security/src/security-plugin-authz-middleware.ts` (~:407). It reads the master object's label through `t(objectLabelKey(master), loc)` before the declared schema label. In this card's scenario, an `en` denial sentence names the master with the zh-CN row. The reviewer read this but did not run it. Add it to the reader list above when choosing route (A) or (B).
